data.name: Bhawarlal
data.gender_notes: Bhawarlal is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Bhawarlal is a compound name derived from Bhava, which means 'Lord' or 'God', and Rama, which means 'Lord of the World'. This name signifies the presence and power of the divine in an individual. The name Bhawarlal carries the meaning “Lord of the World” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Hindi. Parents who choose Bhawarlal usually hope their child will grow to embody lord of the world and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Bhawarlal is a name of God in Hinduism, representing the divine power and presence in the world and in individuals. It is believed to bestow strength, courage, and protection.
data.etymology: Bhawarlal belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Lord of the World.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Bhawarlal total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.
